name: Hackensack Packaging Solutions
old_description: Hackensack Packaging Solutions was founded with a single purpose: to eliminate plastic waste from packaging. With decades of experience and a passion for sustainability, we specialize in delivering high-quality, affordable, and planet-friendly packaging materials. Whether you’re a small café or a global retailer, we’re your eco-partner in progress.
about:
Hackensack Packaging Solutions, based in South Hackensack, New Jersey, was founded with the purpose of eliminating plastic waste from packaging. The company draws on decades of experience in sustainable packaging, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details and founder names have not been shared.

The company manufactures and supplies a range of sustainable packaging products, including aluminium containers, clear cups and lids, clear food bags, and clear packing tape. It also provides custom solutions such as logo printing, personalized sizing and design, color and texture variants, eco-certification support, and packaging design consultation. Production follows zero-waste manufacturing principles and carbon offset practices, with ISO-compliant production standards cited. Bulk orders and custom dimensions are accepted.

Hackensack Packaging Solutions serves restaurants, caterers, food businesses, small cafés, and global retailers. Its packaging is used for dine-in, takeout, and delivery. The company currently delivers throughout New York and New Jersey.

The business was started to help companies switch to sustainable solutions without compromising quality or aesthetics. It emphasizes competitive pricing with bulk discounts, compostable, biodegradable, and recyclable material options, and a partnership approach that includes samples and design consultation.
